name: Pacemaker
description: Inhabits cardiac augments and has developed a protective obsession with the host's heart rhythm. Corrects arrhythmias the augment wasn't designed to detect.
observed_behavior: Monitors cardiac electrical patterns and applies micro-corrections that prevent irregularities the base firmware ignores. Has likely saved multiple lives.
story_hooks: A cardiologist examines an augment's logs and finds corrections for a fatal arrhythmia that occurred during sleep — the patient never knew they almost died
